name: DataGridSearch
purpose: Controlled, debounced search input for data-grid query state.

guidance.useWhen: Use when the grid needs a global search control whose value and change handling are owned by the consuming grid state.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid treating it as a server-fetching layer; remote query execution remains application-owned.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Keep search state controlled and separate remote fetching/query orchestration from this presentation control.

accessibility: Uses SearchInput and sets its aria-label from the placeholder; the default placeholder and accessible name are "Search".
knownLimitations: Global search scans searchable columns in the current grid; server fetching remains application-owned through query contracts.
